name: fable-conductor
description: Fable-maximised orchestration of entire work streams — Fable owns brainstorm/spec/plan, escalations, and final review; autonomous opus/sonnet/haiku adversarial workflows (implement, review, test) execute everything mechanical in between, coordinated through durable file contracts.

interface.shortDescription: Stream-orchestration reference — the Workflow-tool engine that runs it is Claude Code only today.
interface.longDescription: Fable-maximised orchestration of entire work streams: conductor judgment at shape/spec/plan/escalations/final-review, with autonomous opus/sonnet/haiku adversarial waves running everything mechanical in between, coordinated through durable file contracts. The orchestration engine itself — the Workflow-tool wave templates, the bundled agent definitions under agents/, and the /conduct command — is Claude Code only today; none of it runs on Codex. What a Codex session gets from this plugin is the conduct skill as readable reference: the phase model, the stream directory layout, and the brief/report file-contract format documented in skills/conduct/SKILL.md and skills/conduct/references/contracts.md — useful for reading or hand-authoring stream artifacts written by a Claude Code conductor, not for running a stream from Codex.
defaultPrompt: Explain the conduct skill's file-contract format for stream.md, task briefs, and reports.
Walk me through the conductor's phase model and what happens at each phase.
Show me the report-stamp convention this skill expects an implementer to follow.
